description: Reduced Table 1 ZINC comparison (claim C1): GRIT with RRWP, RRWP plus 1-CQRW, RRWP plus 2-QiRW and the matched-width RRWP-41 control, four seeds each, 200 of 2000 epochs. Results are partial.
checkpoint_rule: model with the lowest validation MAE over the 200 epochs, evaluated once on the test split
aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over the four seeds
tie_rule: no winner unless the margin exceeds twice the larger seed standard deviation and a Wilcoxon signed-rank test on seed-averaged per-graph absolute errors gives p < 0.05
selection_rule: none: this sweep compares fixed configurations, no candidate is selected
